responsibility: Implements the XCOFF-specific portion of GCC’s AIX debug emitter on top of the generic dbx/stabs machinery. This file owns XCOFF line and file-change directives (.bf/.ef/.bb/.eb/.bi/.ei/.line), tracking of current function/file/inlining state, assignment of predefined XCOFF fundamental type numbers for intrinsic types, emission of block-local symbols at the right block numbers, and the function-level .function/FE.. records and section-name globals needed so assemblers and debuggers see correct XCOFF symbol-table structure and function extents.
same_name_distinction: Pairs with xcoffout.h as the executable XCOFF-specific emitter: it implements the AIX/XCOFF hooks, such as .bf/.ef/.bb/.eb/.bi/.ei/.line handling, function declarations, and predefined type-number assignment, while calling into dbxout services. Unlike xcoffout.h, which provides macros, policy overrides, globals, and prototypes that configure dbxout.cc for XCOFF, this file emits the actual XCOFF debug records.
